channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Geaney let the wind do the work for winning score
item.description: Conor Geaney has been reflecting on his last-gasp two-point free that handed Dingle a dramatic and historic victory over St Finbarr's in last Sunday's Munster club SFC final.

item.title: Kent joins GAA presidential race
item.description: Wexford GAA have nominated Derek Kent to run for GAA president at Congress next February.

item.title: Donnelly appointed St Eunan's manager
item.description: Kieran Donnelly has been appointed as the new St Eunan's senior football manager.

item.title: Fixture details for All-Ireland club hurling semi-finals announced
item.description: Parnell Park and Semple Stadium will host the All-Ireland club SHC semi-finals on Sunday 21 December.

item.title: Burke takes Camross reins
item.description: Former player Tomás Burke has been appointed as the new Camross senior hurling manager.

item.title: No live TV coverage of All-Ireland ladies club final
item.description: Saturday's All-Ireland ladies football senior club football final between Galway's Kilkerrin-Clonberne St Ergnats of Antrim at Croke Park won't be shown live on TG4.

item.title: Irish quartet sign for AFLW clubs
item.description: The exodus of top ladies football talents to the AFLW continues with another quartet signing for Aussie Rules clubs this week.

item.title: Br Bosco Cup quarter-final draw made
item.description: The draw for the Br Bosco Cup (Leinster Post Primary Schools Senior Football 'A' Championship) quarter-finals has taken place.

item.title: Tipperary All-Ireland documentary on the way
item.description: Tipperary GAA is releasing a behind-the-scenes documentary this Christmas charting the county's journey to All-Ireland hurling glory.

item.title: 2026 Cork GAA Championship draws take place
item.description: The draws have been made for the 2026 Cork GAA adult championships.
